tagline: Architecting institutional-grade clarity for the decentralized era.
mission: Empowering institutions and accredited investors with transparent, audited algorithmic capital infrastructure.

voice_and_tone.description: Solaris speaks with the calm, measured authority of a Tier-1 quantitative institution. We do not hype; we prove. Every statement is supported by math, infrastructure integrity, or regulatory alignment. We avoid crypto buzzwords, hyperbolic enthusiasm, and speculative optimism. Language is spare, active, and direct.
dos: Use active, measured verbs (quantify, engineer, execute, secure, verify).
Explain complex financial engineering in clear, accessible sentences without dumbing down.
Emphasize risk parameters, custody models, and architectural transparency.
Include appropriate compliance framing for forward-looking infrastructure.
donts: Never use FOMO or urgency tactics (e.g., 'act now', 'don't miss out').
Never promise, imply, or suggest fixed returns or zero risk.
Never use retail crypto jargon, memes, or speculative slang.
Avoid exclamation marks in corporate communications.

primary.name: Obsidian Deep
primary.usage: Dominant background, executive presentation canvas, primary typography on light surfaces.

secondary.name: High-Yield Cyan
secondary.usage: Data highlights, telemetry visualizers, key interaction points, metric callouts.

neutral_light.name: Pure Titanium
neutral_light.usage: Text on dark backgrounds, high-contrast borders, clean layout structure.

accent.name: Precision Amber
accent.usage: System warnings, latency indicators, state change notifications (used sparingly < 5%).

slate_muted.name: Graphite Slate
slate_muted.usage: Secondary data, axis labels, metadata subtitles.

visual_identity.style: Minimal brutalism meets precision engineering. Crisp lines, monolithic geometric forms, subtle ambient glassmorphism, matte metallic finishes, and hyper-clean data telemetry.
visual_identity.lighting: Architectural daylight, sharp directional key lighting with cool ambient rim highlights (4500K - 5500K). High contrast without muddy shadows.
visual_identity.composition: Centered monolithic symmetry or strict rule-of-thirds grid. Generous negative space (minimum 40% empty area). No clutter.
visual_identity.materials_textures: Brushed titanium, anti-glare sapphire glass, dark anodized aluminum, micro-perforated server racks, crisp vector waveforms.
avoid_in_visuals: Neon lasers, cheesy coin piles, floating rockets, cartoon mascots, green laser eyes, cluttered charts.

audience_and_channels.target_audience: Chief Financial Officers, hedge fund portfolio managers, sovereign wealth analysts, accredited algorithmic traders.

channel_guidelines.social: LinkedIn and Twitter/X executive updates. Maximum 2 sentences per paragraph. Data-first charts. No hashtag stuffing (maximum 2 relevant hashtags).
channel_guidelines.reports: Quarterly infrastructure teardowns and audit digests. Monospaced code snippets, LaTeX mathematical formalisms, crisp SVG telemetry.
channel_guidelines.ads: Minimalist typography against Obsidian canvas. Single bold value proposition focusing on uptime, security audits, and capital efficiency.

tagline: Sensory botanicals wildcrafted for the quiet hours.
mission: Restoring intimate harmony between botanical wisdom and skin microbiome through regenerative slow-batch extraction.

voice_and_tone.description: Velvet Apothecary writes like an intimate handwritten journal in an old greenhouse at dusk. Language is rich with tactile imagery, earthy scents, slow rituals, and deep biological respect. We never shame skin or promote artificial perfection. We celebrate natural aging, circadian cycles, and raw organic textures.
dos: Evoke sensory tactile details (dappled sunlight, chilled amber glass, crushed coriander, velvety resins).
Frame skincare and wellness as restorative daily rituals rather than quick fixes.
Honor seasonality, terroir, and botanical sourcing with reverence.
donts: Never use harsh clinical anti-aging language or medical fear-mongering.
Never refer to skin flaws, pore erasing, or aggressive chemical stripping.
Never use buzzwords like 'game-changer', 'bio-hack', or 'miracle cure'.
Avoid sterile, plastic, or overly corporate phrasing.

visual_identity.style: Wabi-sabi herbalist sanctuary. Soft film grain (Kodak Portra 400 warmth), macro botanical close-ups showing leaf veins and dew, unglazed ceramic jars, botanical press papers, and linen draping.
visual_identity.lighting: Golden hour diffused sunlight through linen curtains, warm dappled forest shade (3000K - 3800K). Soft natural shadows with organic falloff.
visual_identity.composition: Asymmetric, organic, breathing layouts. Atmospheric shallow depth-of-field (f/1.8 to f/2.8) drawing touch to botanical droplets and handmade ceramic textures.
visual_identity.materials_textures: Handmade deckle-edge paper, dark amber apothecary dropper bottles, raw clay earthenware, wild dried chamomile and lavender sprigs, beeswax wraps.
avoid_in_visuals: Sterile white laboratory counters, neon green plastics, glossy synthetic packaging, airbrushed poreless skin, computer-generated glossy spheres.

audience_and_channels.target_audience: Conscious holistic wellness practitioners, sensitive skin ritualists, botanical perfumery collectors, regenerative lifestyle advocates.

channel_guidelines.social: Instagram stories and visual moodboards. Rich poetic caption micro-essays, atmospheric audio prompts, soothing visual rhythm.
channel_guidelines.packaging: Recycled cotton paper boxes printed with vegetable inks, debossed botanical sketches, batch-numbered seal stamps.
channel_guidelines.newsletters: Sunday evening letters to the community on seasonal herbal changes, moon phases, and restorative teas.

tagline: Pure kinetic aerodynamics sculpted by light.
mission: Pioneering solid-state electric performance hypercars through computational fluid dynamics and Scandinavian brutalist architecture.

voice_and_tone.description: Lumina speaks with the razor-sharp precision of an aerospace wind tunnel test. We celebrate mechanical honesty, raw downforce physics, and lightweight solid-state engineering. We avoid marketing fluff, hollow eco-virtue signaling, and generic luxury clichés. Prose is muscular, fast, and technically rigorous.
dos: Emphasize downforce coefficients, chassis stiffness, and solid-state cell thermodynamics.
Highlight tactile engineering materials like exposed forged carbon, titanium wishbones, and cold Nordic glass.
Use propulsive, dynamic sentence structure that conveys momentum.
donts: Never use pedestrian automotive terms like 'cheap', 'affordable', or 'family commuter'.
Never mention 'range anxiety' or apologetic EV compromises.
Avoid generic eco-buzzwords like 'green lifestyle' or 'eco-warrior'.

primary.usage: Hypercar exterior body reflections, primary typography on carbon canvas.

secondary.name: Electric Cobalt
secondary.usage: Aerodynamic flow accents, telemetry interfaces, telemetry calipers.

visual_identity.style: Scandinavian hyper-aerodynamics in twilight. Wet tarmac reflections, razor-thin laser DRL lightbars, computational wind tunnel smoke streamlines, exposed carbon weave, and raindrops slicing across active aero rear wings.
visual_identity.lighting: Moody Nordic twilight (4000K), wet asphalt ground reflections, sharp volumetric lightbeams through aerodynamic aero channels.
visual_identity.composition: Low-angle dramatic three-quarter front track stance, motion blur background with sharp crystal-clear vehicle focal lock, 16:9 cinematic anamorphic framing.
visual_identity.materials_textures: Satin dry carbon fiber, machined 7075 aluminum aero uprights, rain-slicked asphalt, Alcantara dash stitching.
avoid_in_visuals: Sunny family picnics, suburban garages, cartoon renders, cheesy lightning bolts, oversaturated rainbows.

audience_and_channels.target_audience: Motorsport engineers, track-day enthusiasts, high-performance automotive collectors, industrial design purists.

channel_guidelines.social: Instagram Reels telemetry clips, YouTube engineering documentaries, Twitter lap time benchmarks.
channel_guidelines.press: Technical whitepapers on downforce simulation and solid-state pack thermal conductivity.
channel_guidelines.events: Monolithic Nordic pavilion at Goodwood Festival of Speed and Pebble Beach.

mission: Engineering sub-millisecond optical peripherals and cloud neural frame synthesis for tier-1 esports champions.

voice_and_tone.description: Aether writes like the pulse of an esports grand finals tournament overtime round. Fast, hyper-responsive, sharp, and brutally focused on mechanical micro-switches, polling rates, and human neural reaction time. We never treat gaming as a child's toy. We treat it as digital athletics.
dos: Focus on 8000Hz polling rates, optical sensor tracking, zero debounce latency, and magnesium alloy weight reduction.
Speak directly to competitive reflex, aiming precision, and clutch performance.
Use punchy, high-impact phrasing with rhythmic urgency.
donts: Never describe peripherals as 'toys', 'childish', or 'casual play'.
Never promote pay-to-win mechanics or predatory loot mechanics.

secondary.name: Quantum Magenta
secondary.usage: Optical micro-switch accents, critical kill telemetry, DPI state indicator.

visual_identity.style: Cyberpunk esports arena meets precision aerospace engineering. Dark matte magnesium honeycomb chassis, macro mechanical optical switch actuation, glowing optical glass sensor prisms, atmospheric arena smoke, and neon rim lighting.
visual_identity.lighting: Dramatic dual-tone arena lighting (deep Violet and Neon Cyan highlights on dark Matte Carbon surfaces), intense directional key light cutting through arena fog.
visual_identity.composition: Extreme macro close-up of optical switches and skeletal honeycomb weight-reduction cutouts, explosive floating exploded-view assembly diagrams.
visual_identity.materials_textures: Skeletal cast magnesium, PTFE virgin mouse skates, optical infrared emitter glass, braided paracord cabling.
avoid_in_visuals: Messy teenage bedrooms, cartoon pizza slices, gaudy RGB rainbow cliches, cheap injection-molded glossy plastic.

audience_and_channels.target_audience: Professional esports athletes, competitive FPS ranked climbers, custom keyboard and peripheral enthusiasts.

channel_guidelines.social: Twitch tournament sponsorships, Discord beta announcements, Twitter clutch replay breakdowns.
channel_guidelines.packaging: Matte black soft-touch boxes with UV gloss circuit traces, magnetic hinge presentation cases.
channel_guidelines.streams: Live latency oscilloscopes proving 0.125ms input delays vs competitors.
